phase_unknown.label: MPN care phase is not established.

apbp.label: Accelerated/blast-phase MPN: urgent AML-like/clinical-trial strategy with early transplant evaluation and MPN-specific supportive care.

recommendation.title: Accelerated/blast-phase MPN: urgent AML-like/clinical-trial strategy with early transplant evaluation and MPN-specific supportive care.

options.label: Disease-directed therapy
options.text: Use AML-like or lower-intensity approach based on fitness/biology.

options.label: Allogeneic transplant
options.text: Early referral when eligible.

mf_low_sym.label: Lower-risk myelofibrosis: observation or symptom-directed therapy based on spleen/constitutional symptoms and counts.

recommendation.title: Lower-risk myelofibrosis: observation or symptom-directed therapy based on spleen/constitutional symptoms and counts.

options.label: Observation
options.text: For asymptomatic/stable lower-risk disease.

options.label: JAK inhibitor or symptom-directed therapy
options.text: When symptomatic splenomegaly/constitutional symptoms warrant treatment.

mf_anemia.label: Myelofibrosis-associated anemia: anemia-directed therapy selected by EPO level, transfusion dependence, mutations, prior therapy and symptom burden.

recommendation.title: Myelofibrosis-associated anemia: anemia-directed therapy selected by EPO level, transfusion dependence, mutations, prior therapy and symptom burden.

options.label: Anemia-directed therapy
options.text: Use source-listed ESA, luspatercept, danazol, momelotinib or other options according to prerequisites.

mf_hct.label: Higher-risk myelofibrosis with transplant candidacy: allogeneic HCT evaluation, often with JAK-inhibitor bridging/symptom control.

recommendation.title: Higher-risk myelofibrosis with transplant candidacy: allogeneic HCT evaluation, often with JAK-inhibitor bridging/symptom control.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT
options.text: Curative-intent option for eligible higher-risk disease.

options.label: Bridge/symptom control
options.text: Use JAK inhibitor or source-defined therapy before HCT as appropriate.

mf_high_nonhct.label: Higher-risk myelofibrosis not proceeding to HCT: JAK-inhibitor/symptom-directed therapy, anemia management, or clinical trial.

recommendation.title: Higher-risk myelofibrosis not proceeding to HCT: JAK-inhibitor/symptom-directed therapy, anemia management, or clinical trial.

options.label: JAK inhibitor
options.text: Select by platelets, anemia, prior therapy and comorbidity.

options.label: Clinical trial/other disease-directed therapy
options.text: For inadequate response/progression.

pv_low.label: Low-risk polycythemia vera: hematocrit control, low-dose aspirin when appropriate, and symptom/risk-directed cytoreduction in selected circumstances.

recommendation.title: Low-risk polycythemia vera: hematocrit control, low-dose aspirin when appropriate, and symptom/risk-directed cytoreduction in selected circumstances.

options.label: Phlebotomy/hematocrit control
options.text: Maintain source target.

options.label: Low-dose aspirin
options.text: When not contraindicated.

options.label: Cytoreduction
options.text: For source-defined selected low-risk indications.

pv_high.label: High-risk polycythemia vera: hematocrit control + aspirin + cytoreductive therapy, with switch for intolerance/resistance.

recommendation.title: High-risk polycythemia vera: hematocrit control + aspirin + cytoreductive therapy, with switch for intolerance/resistance.

options.label: Cytoreductive therapy
options.text: Use preferred interferon/hydroxyurea or source-listed alternatives based on age/pregnancy/comorbidity.

options.label: Second-line
options.text: Use ruxolitinib/other source options for HU resistance/intolerance as appropriate.

et_low.label: Prior cytoreductive therapy inadequate response/loss of response?

et_1.label: Very-low/low/intermediate-risk ET: observation/aspirin and selective cytoreduction based on thrombosis risk, symptoms, and cardiovascular factors.

recommendation.title: Very-low/low/intermediate-risk ET: observation/aspirin and selective cytoreduction based on thrombosis risk, symptoms, and cardiovascular factors.

options.label: Aspirin/observation
options.text: Use source risk and symptom criteria.

options.label: Cytoreduction
options.text: For selected intermediate-risk or symptomatic states.

et_high_action.label: High-risk essential thrombocythemia: antiplatelet therapy plus cytoreduction with source-preferred agents.

recommendation.title: High-risk essential thrombocythemia: antiplatelet therapy plus cytoreduction with source-preferred agents.

options.label: Cytoreductive therapy
options.text: Use interferon/hydroxyurea or other source-listed therapy.

options.label: Aspirin
options.text: Risk-adapted once/twice daily where appropriate.

et_3.label: ET with inadequate response/loss of response to prior cytoreduction: switch to source-listed subsequent cytoreductive therapy.

recommendation.title: ET with inadequate response/loss of response to prior cytoreduction: switch to source-listed subsequent cytoreductive therapy.

options.label: Subsequent cytoreduction
options.text: Use preferred ropeginterferon alfa-2b-njft or other source-listed option according to prior therapy/contraindications.

workup.label: Suspected/unclassified MPN: complete workup, marrow/cytogenetics and molecular testing, then assign diagnosis and risk.

recommendation.title: Suspected/unclassified MPN: complete workup, marrow/cytogenetics and molecular testing, then assign diagnosis and risk.

options.label: Diagnostic workup
options.text: CBC/smear, marrow, cytogenetics and JAK2/CALR/MPL + broader NGS as source-defined.

options.label: Risk stratification
options.text: Apply subtype-specific MF/PV/ET prognostic models after diagnosis.
